prose.subject: Friendly Reminder: Invoice INV-10748
prose.body:
Hi Driftmoor Retail team,

Hope you’re having a great week! Just a quick, friendly nudge regarding invoice INV-10748 for the amount of 7053.39 USDC. We noticed this hasn’t been settled yet, so we wanted to reach out to ensure everything is on track.

To process the payment, please send the funds to our standard vendor wallet: 0x24884d8e82234922f417be28b51d62a00c8a7d59. This is the same address we have used for previous transactions, so no changes are needed on your end.

If you’ve already sent the payment, feel free to ignore this note or drop us a line with the transaction hash so we can update our records promptly. If you have any questions about the invoice details or need a copy of the original document, just let us know and we’ll be happy to help.

Thanks for your prompt attention to this! We appreciate your partnership and look forward to continuing our work together.

Best regards,

The Billing Team
Quillon Legal
